title: Earth's Rotation Mystery Solved in 9 MINUTES!
description:
Ever wondered who keeps the Earth spinning around the Sun? Does it need an energy source like a cosmic health drink or divine superpower? Or is there a simple scientific explanation?

In this video, Pale Blue Thoughts breaks down the physics of why Earth spins without stopping. Using Newton’s First Law of Motion, we explain why objects in motion stay in motion unless acted upon by an external force. Unlike a ball rolling on the ground that slows down due to friction and air resistance, space is almost frictionless. That’s why Earth doesn’t need extra energy to keep spinning — it would actually take force to stop it .

We also dive into the conservation of angular momentum. Earth formed from dust and gas clouds in the early solar system, each particle carrying its own tiny spin. As they clumped together, their momentum was conserved, creating a rotating planet. That’s why all planets, stars, and galaxies spin. Even asteroids and comets spin, though irregularly, depending on their history and forces like outgassing.

This isn’t perpetual motion magic — it’s just physics. Earth has been spinning for 4.6 billion years and will keep doing so unless acted on by external forces. If someone asks “who keeps the Earth spinning?” — the answer is simple: no one needs to. It spins because of physics.

If you’ve searched for why Earth spins, Newton’s laws explained, conservation of angular momentum, Earth spin physics, or why planets rotate, this video breaks it down.
